Protein Group

Mushrooms

About This Group

Twelve globally recognized edible mushrooms from Agaricus to chanterelle, prized for their savory, umami-rich depth.

Culinary mushrooms are protein-rich fungi used as center-of-plate or supporting protein — umami drivers for wine pairing through butter, cream, and roast techniques.

FAQ

Why are button, cremini, and portobello separate entities?
Same species (Agaricus bisporus) but distinct commercial maturity stages with different cooking and pairing context.
How does edible_structure differ from plant_part?
Mushrooms use fungal_body; plant_part is empty — fungi are not botanical plants.
